context: A grandmother gives her granddaughter nutrition advice
purpose: Teach: 保健/診療/出産/心臓/栄養/毛/透明/願っ

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: さくら、ちゃんとご飯食べてる?おばあちゃん、あなたの栄養が心配でね。
lines.en: Sakura, are you eating proper meals? Grandma is worried about your nutrition.
lines.style: Warm grandmotherly tone, gentle but concerned, slight rising inflection on the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うーん、保健の授業ではバランスよく食べなさいって習ったけど、コンビニご飯ばっかり…
lines.en: Um, in health class they told us to eat a balanced diet, but it's been all convenience store food...
lines.style: Teen girl trailing off sheepishly, mildly embarrassed, casual youthful intonation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: それじゃダメよ。お母さんがあなたを出産した日、元気に育ってねって心から願ったのよ。
lines.en: That won't do. The day your mother gave birth to you, she wished from the heart for you to grow up healthy.
lines.style: Soft but firm, slight emotional weight on the wish, delivered with maternal warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかってるよ…でも忙しくて。髪の毛もパサパサだし、朝起きると心臓がドキドキしてる時もあって。
lines.en: I know... but I'm busy. My hair is all dry, and sometimes when I wake up my heart is pounding.
lines.style: Slightly whiny teen voice, touching her hair self-consciously, then admitting something worrying.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あらまあ、それは本当にダメ。明日、近所のクリニックで診療を受けてきなさい。
lines.en: Oh my, that's really not good. Tomorrow, go get a medical exam at the neighborhood clinic.
lines.style: Concerned grandmotherly tone, then turning practical and instructive, slow steady pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、行ってくる…ねえ、おばあちゃんのスープって、透明なのに体に染みるよね。久しぶりに食べたいな。
lines.en: Yeah, I'll go... Hey, Grandma, your soup is clear but it really soaks into your body. I want to have it again.
lines.style: Softening, changing subject affectionately, nostalgic and a little wistful tone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、明日作ってあげる。野菜たっぷりでね、あなたが元気でいてくれるのが一番の願いだから。
lines.en: Hehe, I'll make it for you tomorrow. With lots of vegetables, because you being well is my biggest wish.
lines.style: Soft chuckle, melting into tenderness, gentle promise-making cadence.
